The '''36th Producers Guild of America Awards''' (also known as '''2025 Producers Guild Awards''' or '''2025 PGA Awards'''), honoring the best [[Film producer|film]] and [[television producer]]s of 2024, were held at the [[The Century Plaza Hotel|Fairmont Century Plaza]] in [[Los Angeles]], California on February 8, 2025.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Verhoeven |first1=Beatrice |last2=Thomas |first2=Carly |last3=Lewis |first3=Hilary |title=PGA Awards: ''Anora'' Takes Home Top Film Prize |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/2025-producers-guild-awards-winners-list-1236131164/ |access-date=November 21, 2025 |work=[[The Hollywood Reporter]] |date=February 8, 2025}}</ref><ref>{{cite press release|title=The Producers Guild of America Awards ''Anora'', ''Shōgun'', ''Hacks'' and ''The Wild Robot'' Top Honors at the 36th Annual Producers Guild Awards |url=https://producersguild.org/2025-pga-awards-winners/ |publisher=[[Producers Guild of America]] |access-date=November 21, 2025 |location=Los Angeles, CA |date=February 8, 2025}}</ref><ref>{{cite |date=December 13, 2024}}</ref> The announcement of the remaining nominations for film and television was originally scheduled for January 10, 2025, but postponed twice due to the [[January 2025 Fires |url=https://variety.com/2025/film/news/producer-guild-awards-nominations-postponed-1236270806/ |access-date=January 9, 2025 |work=[[Variety (magazine)|Variety]] |date=January 9, 2025}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|last=Petski|first=Denise|title=PGA Awards Postpones Nominations Announcement Again Due to L.A. Wildfires|url=https://deadline.com/2025/01/pga-awards-postpones-nominations-l-a-wildfires-1236252558/|access-date=January 12, 2025|date=January 12, 2025|work=[[Deadline Hollywood]]}}</ref> and those nominations were ultimately announced on January 16, 2025.<ref>{{cite news|last=Petski|first=Denise|title=PGA Awards Nominations Include ''Dune: Part Two'', ''The Brutalist'', ''Wicked'' Vying for Top Film Prize|url=https://deadline.com/2025/01/pga-awards-producers-guild-nominations-2025-list-1236258623/|work=[[Deadline Hollywood]]|access-date=January 16, 2025|date=January 16, 2025}}</ref><ref>{{cite press release |author=<!--Not stated--> |title=2025 Producers Guild Award Nominees Announced for Motion Picture and Television Program Categories|url=https://producersguild.org/2025-pga-awards-motion-pictures-and-television-categories-nominees/ |location=Los Angeles |publisher=[[Producers Guild of America]] |agency= |date=January 16, 2025 |access-date=January 17, 2025}}</ref> The finalists for the PGA Innovation Award were announced on November 14, 2024.<ref name="PGAInnovationAwardFinalists">{{cite press release |author=<!--Not stated--> |title=Producers Guild of America Announces Finalists and Expansion of "The PGA Innovation Award" for the 36th Annual Producers Guild Awards|url=https://producersguild.org/2025-pga-awards-innovation-award-finalists/ |location=Los Angeles |publisher=[[Producers Guild of America]] |agency= |date=November 14, 2024 |access-date=November 27, 2024}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last1=Pedersen |first1=Erik |title=Producers Guild Reveals Finalists For Its 2025 Innovation Award |url=https://deadline.com/2024/11/producers-guild-innovation-award-finalists-2025-1236177528/ |website=[[Deadline Hollywood]] |access-date=November 27, 2024 |date=November 14, 2024}}</ref>

The PGA Innovation Award was presented on February 6, 2025, during the PGA nominees event in Los Angeles.<ref name="PGAInnovationAwardFinalists" /><ref>{{cite press release|title=Winners of the Short Form and PGA Innovation Awards Announced as part of the West Coast Celebration of the Producers Guild Awards taking place on February 8 |url=https://producersguild.org/2025-pga-awards-short-form-and-innovation-award-winners/ |publisher=[[Producers Guild of America]] |access-date=November 21, 2025 |location=Los Angeles, CA |date=February 6, 2025}}</ref>
